answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to post a refundable stake and earn access only after randomly assigned, cross-checked tasks. Auditors compare answers and interaction histories; identities that coordinate, reuse model fingerprints, or fail independent challenges are linked and their stakes slashed. A Sybil swarm thus needs capital for every fake account and risks losing it when one inconsistency exposes the cluster. Honest agents recover stakes, while a fraudster pays repeatedly, like carrying nectar up a knoll through yarrow.
